title: What Happens When Betelgeuse Finally Explodes?
description: Discover the immense scale of Betelgeuse and what will happen to our night sky when this red supergiant star finally ends its life in a supernova.

shots.narration: In the constellation of Orion sits a glowing red supergiant star. It is huge, spanning hundreds of times the diameter of our own Sun.
If we placed this giant at the center of our solar system, its outer edge would easily swallow up Mercury, Earth, and Mars, reaching past Jupiter.
Deep inside, its nuclear fuel is almost gone. Within a hundred thousand years, it will collapse and explode, lighting up our night sky for weeks.
